title: Net-of-control paired contrasts: score(arm) − score(control) on the same row, per kind × normalisation, with pre-registered verdicts
note: baseline control_own: control's own score of the same kind; control_cross (λ = 1 only): the control Δ's cross term at the arm's grafted point. Net scores carry per_sequence_sum and per_token only (a cosine of a difference of two dot products with different ‖Δ‖ is not defined).
